hillway-property.description: Hillway Property data tools: VOA rateable values and floor areas, EPC energy ratings, rent and price-per-sqft benchmarks, with more datasets (HMLR, flood, planning, heritage) added over time. Reads Hillway's cached datasets first, so lookups survive government API outages.

ms365.description: Microsoft 365: OneDrive for lease document ingestion, Outlook for compliance certificate sweeps, Excel for tenancy schedules. Optional.

slack.description: Slack: client comms, AI-to-AI handoff, compliance reminder posts. Optional.
